recentEpisodes.title: The Value of Friendship | KIPG Podcast Ep. 14
recentEpisodes.description: What makes a friendship last for decades? In Episode 14 of the KIPG Podcast, PG and Troy sit down with longtime friends Michael, Torrence, and Kevin for a conversation about the value of real friendship. These aren’t friendships that started yesterday. We’re talking about more than 30 years of life together — growing up, growing older, laughing, going through difficult seasons, holding one another accountable, and somehow still being able to become kids again when everybody gets together. This episode is less about giving a formula for friendship and more about sharing what genuine friendship looks like when it has been tested by time, change, disagreements, victories, losses, faith, and life itself. We talk about what brought us together, what has kept us connected, the importance of having people who will tell you the truth, and why some friendships eventually become family. If you’ve ever had a friend who has walked with you through different seasons of your life, this conversation is for you. Real topics. Real conversations. Real answers. Subscribe to the KIPG Podcast and join us each week for conversations about faith, relationships, life, purpose, and the issues that matter. Episode 14 — The Value of Friendship #KIPGPodcast #Friendship #Brotherhood #RealFriendship #ChristianPodcast

recentEpisodes.title: The Dangers of Gossip & Slander: When Words Destroy | KIPG Podcast Ep. 13
recentEpisodes.description: Gossip and slander can damage reputations, relationships, churches, families, workplaces, and communities — sometimes faster than the truth can repair them. In Episode 13 of the KIPG Podcast, PG and Troy take a deeper look at the dangers of gossip and slander: why people do it, how spiritual language can sometimes be used to disguise it, what happens when rumors become character assassination, and what to do when you become the target. We also talk about accountability, forgiveness, wisdom in what we repeat, and why being a listener to gossip can be just as dangerous as being the one spreading it. This conversation is about more than romantic relationships or church drama. Gossip and slander can happen anywhere — among friends, family, coworkers, leaders, social media circles, and even people who claim they are only “sharing a concern.” KIPG Podcast Real topics. Real conversations. Real answers. New episodes every Wednesday at 7PM ET on YouTube. Episode 13: The Dangers of Gossip & Slander #KIPGPodcast #GossipAndSlander #ChristianPodcast #CharacterAssassination #BiblicalWisdom

episodes.title: Finding Joy During Dry Seasons | KIPG Podcast Ep. 10
episodes.description: What do you do when you’re praying, believing, and trying to stay faithful—but God seems silent? In this episode of the KIPG Podcast, Pastor George and Troy talk about those dry or wilderness seasons where answers feel delayed, life feels uncertain, and you can’t clearly see what God is doing. Sometimes the hardest part is trusting God when you don’t have control over the timing, the process, or the outcome. Joy doesn’t always come because everything changed. Sometimes it comes when you reconnect with the true source and learn to trust God even when you can’t see what He’s doing. 🎙️ KIPG Podcast Real Topics. Real Conversations. Real Answers. New episodes every Wednesday at 7 PM ET. Question for you: Have you ever gone through a season where God seemed quiet, but later you realized He was still working?

episodes.title: Episode 9 — Character vs. Gifting: The Need for Healthy Biblical Accountability
episodes.description: 🎙️ KIPG Podcast — Episode 9 Character vs. Gifting: The Need for Healthy Biblical Accountability Can someone be incredibly gifted and still lack the character needed to lead? In Episode 9 of the KIPG Podcast, Pastor George and Troy are joined by special guests Tito & Jessica for an honest conversation about gifting, character, leadership, accountability, and the rise of celebrity Christianity. We examine some uncomfortable questions: Can gifting cause us to overlook character? Have we created a church culture that elevates personalities too quickly? Has “Touch not God’s anointed” sometimes been used to protect leaders from legitimate accountability? And when correction is necessary, where is the line between biblical accountability and simply tearing someone down? Being talented, charismatic, influential, or even spiritually gifted does not automatically mean someone is ready to lead. This conversation isn’t about attacking leaders. It’s about creating healthier leadership, healthier churches, and understanding that accountability and honor can exist at the same time. Join Pastor George, Troy, Tito, and Jessica as we talk through the tension between character and gifting and why both matter. 🎙️ KIPG Podcast Real Topics. Real Conversations. Real Answers. 📅 New conversations every Wednesday at 7 PM ET If this conversation makes you think, join us in the comments: What matters more in a leader — gifting or character? And can you truly have one without the other? Tito & Jessica Tosado: Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/6LlVIVnpne75qIbHCAcrpz?si=6FHrYDtcRfyq29H_dApqdA Jessica - @jessinlivingcolor [Instagram] Tito - @teedoe.t [Instagram] #KIPGPodcast #ChristianLeadership #BiblicalAccountability #CelebrityChristianity #CharacterVsGifting

Delacruz Grief is a part of life. Whether it comes through loss, disappointment, transition, heartbreak, or unexpected change, grief is a real and necessary process. In this episode of Keeping It PG, Pastor George, Troy, and special guest Sherrita C.W. Delacruz have an honest and heartfelt conversation about good grief—what it means to grieve in a healthy way and how God helps us through the process. While grief itself is not wrong, how we handle it matters. When grief is ignored, suppressed, or processed improperly, it can begin to affect our emotions, relationships, faith, and daily lives. But when we allow God to meet us in those painful places, grief can become a pathway to healing, growth, and restoration. This conversation is designed to encourage anyone who may be carrying sorrow, navigating loss, or trying to understand how to move forward without pretending everything is okay. No matter where you are in your journey, our prayer is that this episode brings comfort, wisdom, perspective, and hope—and reminds you that God is with you even in seasons of grief. 💬 We’d love to hear from you! episodes.description: Welcome to Keeping It PG with Pastor George & Troy🎙️ 🎁 SUPPORT THE PODCAST (100% Fee-Free) Zelle: infopastorgeorge@gmail.com [Directions below] If this conversation encouraged you and you'd like to help us continue creating weekly episodes, your support is greatly appreciated. ______________________________________________________________________ 🎙️ Episode 5 Loneliness can affect anyone. You can be surrounded by family, friends, coworkers, church members, or thousands of people online—and still feel unseen, unheard, and disconnected. In this episode of Keeping It PG, PG and Troy sit down for an honest conversation about loneliness: what it looks like, how it affects our thoughts, emotions, relationships, health, and decision-making, and why so many people struggle to talk about it. We also discuss some of the warning signs, including isolation, irritability, emotional exhaustion, unhealthy attachments, loss of motivation, and the feeling that nobody truly understands what you are going through. This is not an interview. It is a real conversation filled with transparency, perspective, practical options, and hope. We will also explore what the Bible says about loneliness, community, connection, and healing—but this conversation is for everyone, regardless of your background or beliefs. Our goal is not simply to motivate you for a moment. We want to help you recognize what may be happening, understand that you are not alone, and begin taking healthy steps toward freedom, support, and meaningful connection. Join the conversation in the comments: Have you ever felt lonely while surrounded by people? What helped you begin reconnecting? Real topics. Real conversations. Real answers. New episodes every Wednesday at 7:00 PM Eastern on YouTube. #KeepingItPG #loneliness #mentalhealthawareness #youarenotalone #faithandmentalhealth
